description: RUGGED, CAPABLE, NO-ACCIDENT, NONSMOKER, JEEP CAPABILITY, EVERYDAY COMFORT! The 2020 Jeep Cherokee Limited continues to prove that a compact SUV can deliver genuine off-road capability without sacrificing everyday comfort. This 4x4 example comes standard with Jeep's proven Pentastar V6, giving it noticeably more confidence and capability than the front-wheel-drive four-cylinder models in the lineup. Standard 4x4 gives this Cherokee genuine confidence in rain, snow, or unpredictable road conditions, backed by Jeep's decades of off-road engineering heritage. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Cherokee has built its reputation by combining genuine Jeep off-road capability with everyday compact SUV practicality, a balance few rivals in the segment manage as well. Its available V6 power, multiple 4x4 system options, and composed on-road manners continue to make it a smart choice for buyers who want real capability without stepping up to a larger SUV. Shoppers cross-shopping the Cherokee against more car-based compact crossovers consistently cite its genuine off-road pedigree and available V6 towing capability as reasons they chose it over a more street-focused alternative. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Reviewers have consistently praised the Cherokee Limited for its straightforward control layout and genuinely upscale interior for the segment, with the available V6 and turbocharged four-cylinder engines both earning praise over the underpowered base engine. Warranty The odometer is hovering around the 74,565-mile mark, and although the original factory warranty coverage has expired, this Cherokee remains ready for many more miles of dependable service. Extended service plans may be available to provide additional peace of mind and help protect your investment moving forward. Standard Features The Limited trim delivers genuine everyday comfort to the Cherokee lineup, including leather-upholstered seating and soft-touch materials throughout the dashboard and door panels. On this 4x4 configuration specifically, the Limited trim comes standard with Jeep's 3.2-liter Pentastar V6 in place of the front-wheel-drive model's naturally aspirated four-cylinder, giving it a genuinely more capable foundation right from the factory. Mechanical Features Power comes from Jeep's 3.2-liter Pentastar V6, producing 271 horsepower and 239 lb-ft of torque. It's an engine built around smooth, confident power delivery, paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission that keeps the engine operating efficiently across a wide range of driving conditions.
